requests.description:
The DetectEntities operation is deprecated. You should use the DetectEntitiesV2 operation instead.

Inspects the clinical text for a variety of medical entities and returns specific information about them such as entity category, location, and confidence score on that information .
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=ComprehendMedical_20181030.DetectEntities
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_COMPREHEND_MEDICAL_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Inspects the clinical text for a variety of medical entities and returns specific information about them such as entity category, location, and confidence score on that information. Amazon Comprehend Medical only detects medical entities in English language texts.

The DetectEntitiesV2 operation replaces the DetectEntities operation. This new action uses a different model for determining the entities in your medical text and changes the way that some entities are returned in the output. You should use the DetectEntitiesV2 operation in all new applications.

The DetectEntitiesV2 operation returns the Acuity and Direction entities as attributes instead of types.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=ComprehendMedical_20181030.DetectEntitiesV2
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_COMPREHEND_MEDICAL_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Inspects the clinical text for protected health information (PHI) entities and returns the entity category, location, and confidence score for each entity. Amazon Comprehend Medical only detects entities in English language texts.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=ComprehendMedical_20181030.DetectPHI
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_COMPREHEND_MEDICAL_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: InferICD10CM detects medical conditions as entities listed in a patient record and links those entities to normalized concept identifiers in the ICD-10-CM knowledge base from the Centers for Disease Control. Amazon Comprehend Medical only detects medical entities in English language texts.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=ComprehendMedical_20181030.InferICD10CM
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_COMPREHEND_MEDICAL_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: InferRxNorm detects medications as entities listed in a patient record and links to the normalized concept identifiers in the RxNorm database from the National Library of Medicine. Amazon Comprehend Medical only detects medical entities in English language texts.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=ComprehendMedical_20181030.InferRxNorm
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_COMPREHEND_MEDICAL_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
